thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE — high error rate detected for tenant 'nightingale' (dedicated vpc-us-east-2). Symptoms: repeated OOMs and 503 spikes from model workers. Alert trigged at 14:12 UTC.
ashley_oncall: ack, I'm on it. quick triage: 503s from model worker pool, request qps doubled vs baseline.
ryan_sre: looking at hosts now. seeing repeated cuda OOM on worker-17 and worker-21 during model load of redwood-7b-q4_0.
ryan_sre: tail from worker-17: 
```
2026-03-17T14:12:03Z worker-17 model-init failed: cudnn OOM
failed alloc 1.2G
stack: alloc/kv_cache/init
```
ashley_oncall: thanks. impact calc?
maria_pm: customer-visible: checkout model call errors ~12% of requests, increased latency causing retries. Nightingale is on enterprise SLAs (99p < 500ms).
eve_support: pinging account contact @account-nightingale, sending a short note that we're mitigating.
eve_support: @account-nightingale: we're applying a temporary routing override to reduce error rate and will follow up with post-incident notes.
ryan_sre: mitigation proposal (short): 1) apply tenant routing override to pin to redwood-7b-q4_safe (lower memory variant) 2) temporarily add 1 GPU to the dedicated pool 3) enable KV cache warm and reduce max_seq for this tenant to cut mem.
ashley_oncall: will apply the pin now via ops API and notify.
ashley_oncall: executing:
```
POST /internal/v1/tenants/nightingale/overrides
{ "policy": "tenant_pin", "model": "redwood-7b-q4_safe", "reason": "OOM mitigation - live incident" }
```
ops-bot: override accepted. rollout started to 12/12 agents, expected propagation <30s.
ashley_oncall: routing change applied :white_check_mark:. Monitoring error rate and latency.
ryan_sre: watching metrics — 503 rate dropping from 8% -> 1.2% within 2m, p95 latency improving. Worker OOMs stopped on the pinned variant.
maria_pm: suggested follow-ups: schedule a controlled canary to evaluate moving to redwood-7b-v1.2 (customer pre-approved pinned release) once load stabilizes; prepare SLA impact calc and communications if >5m above threshold.
ashley_oncall: documenting in runbook under incident 4225012345. I'll hand off to ryan for night shift monitoring. If error rate creeps back above 2% escalate to oncall-2.
ryan_sre: taking over monitoring. will also create a temporary autoscale rule to add 1 GPU if QPS > baseline*1.5 for 3 consecutive mins.
ashley_oncall: noted. final steps: post-mortem checklist, include logs, override record, and customer timeline.
ashley_oncall: handing off — oncall -> ryan_sre, :wave: please ack.
ryan_sre: ack, taking over. will ping if regressions.
account-nightingale: thanks for the quick response — appreciate the update. keep us posted on rollback plan and SLA notes.
---
(End of thread)
